A short description of the change and why it is needed. Link the issue it
closes, if any (`Closes #...`).

## Checklist

- [ ] `python -m pytest tests/ -q` passes, and new behaviour has a test
- [ ] `ruff check .` passes
- [ ] A change to the core pipeline (solve, reduce, concatenate, parts and
      imports) is reflected in `tutorials/core_workflows.py`
- [ ] Affected documentation pages and notebooks are updated
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under "Unreleased"
